title: centaurium majus var. suffriticosum
intro: Centaurium majus var. suffriticosum, commonly known as Greater Centaury, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat a range of health issues. The health benefits of Centaurium majus var. suffriticosum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects.
